# Summary

Describe the change and the gap it closes. For a new model or method,
state the model class it serves.

Closes #

## Type of change

- [ ] feat (new behaviour)
- [ ] fix (defect)
- [ ] perf (throughput or memory)
- [ ] refactor / docs / test / build / ci / chore

## Checklist

- [ ] One logical change per commit, Conventional Commits format
- [ ] Tests accompany the behaviour and pass locally
- [ ] New code is covered by tests
- [ ] Docstrings explain the failure mode the design prevents
- [ ] `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, and `pyright` are green
- [ ] Docs updated where behaviour changed

## Verification

State how the change was validated with tests, a study, or a benchmark. Paste the
acceptance evidence (numbers, not assertions) where a roadmap item moves
to done.
